description: Screen a crypto wallet address for AML/KYT risk. Returns an AML score (0-100), risk_level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), category, sanctioned exposure and source-of-funds. Read-only: it only looks the address up, it never changes anything.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc or tron.

name: screen_address
title: Screen address for AML risk
